impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of the single main gas export compressor train would force recycle and cut production within an hour; no spare or workaround is available.

tickets.summary: FW-8102 failed its first weekly test start, then started after 8 s and reached rated pressure; recurrent starting-system issues degrade firewater readiness while FW-8101 delivery capability is uncertain.
tickets.recommended_action: Load-test batteries and inspect starting air/circuits; repair findings, then verify first-attempt start and rated pressure. Check and record protection deviation. Load-test battery and starting air. Test FW-8101 rated flow and pressure.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: A required start-on-demand function already failed during the weekly test. The second-attempt start and normal running demonstrate intermittent rather than sustained loss, but confirmed function failure requires the top likelihood band.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure would degrade a safety-critical firewater protection layer. FW-8101 is the stated partner, but its later test showed only 9.2 barg against 11 barg with flow unmeasured, so capable redundancy cannot yet be credited.

tickets.summary: Loose, wind-flapping cladding on the second-stage discharge line is likely to detach if left, creating a dropped-object hazard despite no reported process concern.
tickets.recommended_action: Barricade drop zone; inspect and secure or replace cladding, check adjacent sections, and verify retention. Check personnel exposure below.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Active wind loading on already loose, flapping cladding and the explicit expectation that it will become a dropped object support advanced degradation with likely near-term loss of retention.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Detachment creates a credible dropped-object injury hazard. The available evidence does not establish cladding mass, fall path, or personnel exposure, limiting support to a moderate safety-consequence band.
